name: How do I choose the right size and layout for a rental tiny home?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right size and layout for a rental tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right size and layout depends on your target tenant demographic, local regulations, and the available space on your property. Consider who you want to attract: a single person might be comfortable in 200 sq ft, while a couple might prefer 300-400 sq ft. Prioritize functional spaces like a full bathroom and an efficient kitchen. Open layouts tend to feel more spacious. Also, review local ADU or tiny home size limits, which can dictate maximum dimensions. Work with a designer to optimize the floor plan for appeal and functionality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose size and layout based on target tenants, local regulations, and property space. Prioritize functional bathrooms and kitchens, and consider open layouts to maximize appeal and efficiency.
